decisions: Free accounts receive one Ping per rolling 24 hours; existing cruush+ accounts receive three per rolling 24 hours with a four-hour cooldown; allowances do not roll over.
All eligible senders may select 1, 3, 5, 10, or 15 miles; one Ping may be active for ten minutes; no tier bypasses privacy or safety limits.

Ping accepts no client coordinates, uses only a fresh encrypted server-side location, stores no source coordinates or recipient distances, exposes no delivery count or recipient list, and fails closed when privacy state cannot be verified.

Nearby Ping notifications require a dedicated recipient opt-in plus global push permission, use generic lock-screen copy, and retain the existing heartbeat notification sound when the recipient has sound enabled.
Stealth Mode cannot Ping; Ghost Mode uses only each viewer's existing viewer-specific displayed heart location.
No payment, checkout, top-up, subscription purchase, billing provider, or paid-credit code ships in this branch.
The map is bounded to the fifteen-mile NYC beta service area around the approved operating center; public release copy never publishes the street address or internal coordinates.

Install and notification tutorial steps are independently skippable; all tutorial steps visibly highlight their actual action or map control, and the card never overlaps the target or bottom navigation.
Only senders see a live remaining-time status on expiring messages; permanent and recipient messages remain unchanged.
